PS1 six-sided main canopy and separate upper tip; tapered trunk removes hidden cap geometry. All bark faces retain bark material under baked shading.
Dappled PS1 ground detail replaces repeated ellipse symbols; both forest materials include soft contact shade.
limits: Opening N64 and Deepwood PS1 gallery views are different maps; compare each platform against its own prior capture.
N64 timing is the final 120-frame sample, not a distribution over the whole campaign.

changes: Fractured shaded rock forms replace repeated stone blocks and white peaks.
Natural N64 ground uses shared corner colours; road, water and masonry boundaries stay distinct.
